name: 郑州风云3
english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'Invincible Under Heaven' (the collector-assigned title 'Zhengzhou Storm 3' names this particular server instance). Part of the Fengyun ('Storm') engine family, alongside this collection's fy2/fy2005/fengyun434/moniHuafu. The game bills itself as 'a MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels' — rather than the Jin Yong-flavored wuxia common elsewhere in this collection, it leans into Gu Long's brisk, devil-may-care style of jianghu storytelling. Character creation lets players choose an ethnicity (Han, Miao, Manchu, or Mongol), an unusual touch for this engine family.
